verdict.rationale: KPI reporting and board-ready export is a fair question for a compliance/screening platform, since false-positive rate and review workload are core AML metrics, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only raw data exports of cases, alerts and transactions by date range, plus case filtering. There is no documented metrics view or report covering dispute rate, false-positive rate, approval-rate lift or review workload. Raw exports a user would have to analyze themselves are building blocks, not the capability.
